# llms.txt — pheno-llms-txt

> Generate llms.txt files for Phenotype repos (LLM-friendly README).

## Install
```
pip install pheno-llms-txt
```

## Usage
```pheno-llms-txt                    # writes ./llms.txt from ./pheno-llms-txt.yaml```
```pheno-llms-txt --out docs/llms.txt```

## Public API
- `pheno_llms_txt.LlmConfig` (dataclass with: repo_name, tagline, install, usage, public_api, common_errors, references)
- `pheno_llms_txt.render(config) -> str`
- `pheno_llms_txt.load_config(path) -> LlmConfig`
- `pheno_llms_txt.write_llms_txt(config, dest)`

## Common errors
- `Error: read config at ./pheno-llms-txt.yaml: No such file`: config is optional; safe to ignore or create an empty file
- `Error: parse YAML at ./pheno-llms-txt.yaml: ...`: check the YAML syntax; all fields are optional
- `Wrote llms.txt` (success): file should be 30-80 lines, well under the 200-line cap

- https://llmstxt.org (llms.txt spec)
